All tests pass (4/4, including the new `coreEnqueuesWelcome` acceptance test). The build is green.

## Summary

The change adds a welcome-notification side effect on successful owner creation.

**New class** — `rest/WelcomeNotifier.java`: a small `@Component` with a single responsibility, emitting to a dedicated `NOTIFY` logger a line carrying the owner id and member id. This mirrors the existing `OwnerAuditLogger` pattern (own logger, one job) rather than piling notification logic onto an existing class.

**Wiring** — `OwnerRestControllerV1`: injected `WelcomeNotifier` via the constructor and invoked `welcomeNotifier.welcome(owner)` in `addOwner`, right after the owner is persisted and audited — so it fires only on a successful create, not on validation failures or idempotent replays.

The emitted line (`Welcome owner: id={} memberId={}`) contains both the owner id and the memberId, satisfying the acceptance test which captures the `NOTIFY` logger and asserts a line containing both values.

## Summary

The change adds a welcome-notification side effect on successful owner creation.

**New class** — `rest/WelcomeNotifier.java`: a small `@Component` with a single responsibility, emitting to a dedicated `NOTIFY` logger a line carrying the owner id and member id. This mirrors the existing `OwnerAuditLogger` pattern (own logger, one job) rather than piling notification logic onto an existing class.

**Wiring** — `OwnerRestControllerV1`: injected `WelcomeNotifier` via the constructor and invoked `welcomeNotifier.welcome(owner)` in `addOwner`, right after the owner is persisted and audited — so it fires only on a successful create, not on validation failures or idempotent replays.

The emitted line (`Welcome owner: id={} memberId={}`) contains both the owner id and the memberId, satisfying the acceptance test which captures the `NOTIFY` logger and asserts a line containing both values.
